itemcasino.stats.title: Casino stats
itemcasino.info.vault: Choose the share of the pot you play for. The odds are priced so a draw is worth %s%% of your offering on average, whatever the share: ask for less and the same offering buys a likelier draw. A share hands over that part of every kind of item, rounded down to whole items. A single draw never goes above %s%%. %3$s%% of your offering goes into the pot, win or lose; the rest is gone for good. Drag the slider (Shift for 1 % steps), scroll over it, or hold - and +.
itemcasino.reject.share_too_small: That share of the pot rounds down to no whole item.
itemcasino.jackpot.announce_share: %s has taken %s%% of the casino jackpot, worth %s chips!
itemcasino.tooltip.mine_field: A 5x5 board with hidden mines. Cash out before you find one.
itemcasino.info.mine_field: Chips only: put a Chip Card in the slot (the Cashier gives you one for your items). Turn tiles over on the 5x5 board. Every safe tile raises the multiplier; a mine loses the whole stake. More mines make each step bigger, and riskier. Each multiplier is the fair odds minus a %s%% house edge, so cashing out at any point returns %s%% of the stake on average. A board also stops by itself, cashed out, when the next tile would win more than the table's limit; a large bet simply plays a shorter board. Cash out whenever you like: a player who walks away is cashed out, never forfeited. Hold - and + to go faster, Shift for 5 at a time, or scroll over the mines.
itemcasino.tooltip.dice: Pick a line from 0 to 100 and a side. The less likely the roll, the more it pays.
itemcasino.label.dice_hint: Drag the line, pick a side, roll
itemcasino.info.dice: Chips only: put a Chip Card in the slot (the Cashier gives you one for your items). The server rolls a number from 0.00 to 99.99. Choose a chance between %3$s%% and %4$s%% and a side: under the line or over it. The less likely the bet, the more it pays: the multiplier is the fair odds minus a %1$s%% house edge, so every bet returns %2$s%% of the stake on average. One roll pays a capped amount, so long shots allow a smaller bet. Drag the line (Shift for 0.1%% steps), scroll, or hold - and +.
itemcasino.card.bearer: The chips belong to whoever holds the card
itemcasino.info.cashier: Put items in the lower slot and press Deposit: they become chips on the card at their full value, 1 chip per value point. No card yet? One is made. A card put there adds its chips to yours. To get items back, pick a currency and a count, then Withdraw: it costs their value plus %s%%. Items go to your inventory, or wait in the casino mailbox when it is full. The chips belong to whoever holds the card: guard it like the items it stands for.

itemcasino.bet.caption: Bet
itemcasino.info.slots: Three of a kind pays the multiplier shown in the tables. Pairs pay too: %1$s x%2$s, %3$s x%4$s, %5$s x%6$s, and a pair of %7$s gives the stake back. A pair of %8$s or of %9$s pays nothing. On average the machine returns %10$s%% of what goes in.
